meta.note: Priority scores (0-100) reflect emphasis in official 2024 manifesto documents — higher = greater emphasis

sources.AAP: AAP Manifesto 2024 — Delhi Governance Model Expansion
sources.SP: SP Manifesto 2024 — PDA Alliance (Pichda, Dalit, Alpsankhyak)

parties.name: BJP
top_promises: Viksit Bharat 2047 — Make India a developed nation by centenary of Independence
PM Awas Yojana — 3 crore more housing units
PM Kisan — continued ₹6,000 annual income support
National Education Policy 2020 full implementation
Gati Shakti — ₹11 lakh crore infrastructure investment plan
Ayushman Bharat expansion — ₹5 lakh health cover to all 70+ citizens

parties.name: INC
top_promises: Legal guarantee for MSP to all farmers — main campaign promise
25 lakh government jobs per year filling vacancies
Right to Apprenticeship — 1 year paid internship to all graduates
Caste Census — national caste survey for OBC sub-categorisation
50% women in Congress-formed government Cabinets
NYAY 2.0 — financial assistance to poorest families

parties.name: AAP
top_promises: World-class government schools in every constituency
Mohalla Clinics — free healthcare at neighbourhood level
Free electricity up to 300 units for all households
Anti-corruption governance — open budget & RTI compliance
Women's safety — CCTV in every lane
100% road connectivity and 24x7 clean water supply

parties.name: TMC
top_promises: Lakshmir Bhandar — ₹1,000/month to all women household heads
Duare Sarkar — government services at citizen's doorstep
Fight against Central overreach — state autonomy protection
Kanyashree — girl child education scholarship
Krishak Bandhu — farmer income support scheme
Special focus on Bengali language and cultural rights

parties.name: SP
top_promises: PDA Alliance — Pichda (OBC), Dalit, Alpsankhyak (Minority) welfare
Caste census implementation and OBC reservation protection
Sugarcane fair price — timely payment to farmers within 15 days
Unemployment allowance to youth awaiting government jobs
Expressway economy — UP development through connectivity
Laptop/tablet to meritorious students in government colleges

BJP.detail: Ram Mandir inaugurated on January 22, 2024 in Ayodhya.
Article 370 abrogated on August 5, 2019; J&K reorganised into two Union Territories.
Uttarakhand enacted state-level UCC in 2024. National UCC not enacted.
Farm income increased but CACP data shows target of doubling not fully achieved by 2022.
Over 10 crore Ujjwala connections given to BPL households as per MoPNG data.

BJP.promise: PM Awas Yojana — 3 crore rural houses
BJP.detail: Over 2.9 crore houses sanctioned; construction ongoing per MoRD.
India became 5th largest economy; $5 trillion target extended to 2027.

INC.detail: INC lost 2019 election; NYAY scheme was not implemented.

INC.promise: Legal guarantee for MSP to farmers (2024)
INC.detail: INC did not form government in 2024; policy not enacted.
Could not be implemented as INC did not form government in 2019 or 2024.

INC.promise: Right to Apprenticeship — 1 year paid internship (2024)
INC.detail: Not enacted — INC not in power at Centre.
Raised as campaign issue; Bihar caste census done at state level. National census pending.
